text: Do you currently have any chest pain, wheezing, or swelling in your legs? Also, do you smoke or have any known heart conditions?

text: Do you experience wheezing or feel tightness in your chest during these episodes? I would also like to request a chest X-ray to rule out any underlying lung pathology.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: 10-year history of hypertension, currently managed with enalapril. History of smoking half a pack of cigarettes daily for 16 years. Social history: Smoker, half a pack of cigarettes daily for 16 years.

speaker: Doctor
text: Are you currently taking any other medications, and do you experience orthopnea or paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea or orthopnea, and have you noticed any swelling in your legs or ankles? I would also like to request an Echocardiogram to evaluate your heart function given your history of hypertension. REQUEST TEST: Echocardiogram

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the recent upper respiratory infection and persistent cough, I suspect post-infectious cough or possibly ACE-inhibitor induced cough. Let's check your lung function to rule out reactive airway disease. REQUEST TEST: Spirometry

speaker: Doctor
text: The spirometry indicates obstructive lung disease, likely COPD given your smoking history. Do you notice wheezing or chest tightness during these episodes, and have you tried any inhalers in the past?

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the obstructive spirometry and smoking history, this is likely COPD exacerbated by a recent infection. DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
